arguments.sql:
WITH helmet_parties AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, p.party_type, p.statewide_vehicle_type,
           p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
               OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used') AS used,
           p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
               OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used') AS not_used
    FROM main.parties AS p
    WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%'
),
collision_counts AS (
    SELECT motorcycle_collision, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS cases,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS missing_fatality_counts
    FROM main.collisions
    GROUP BY motorcycle_collision
),
helmet_cases AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, MAX(p.used) AS used, MAX(p.not_used) AS not_used
    FROM helmet_parties AS p
    JOIN main.collisions AS c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1 AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY p.case_id
)
SELECT 'collision flag / case uniqueness / missing fatalities' AS diagnostic,
       CAST(motorcycle_collision AS TEXT) AS category, rows AS count_1, cases AS count_2,
       missing_fatality_counts AS count_3
FROM collision_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'party types with explicit helmet codes in motorcycle collisions', p.party_type, COUNT(*),
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN p.not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM helmet_parties AS p
JOIN main.collisions AS c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
GROUP BY p.party_type
UNION ALL
SELECT 'driver or passenger collision-level helmet statuses', 'used / not used / both',
       SUM(CASE WHEN used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN used AND not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM helmet_cases

arguments.sql:
WITH collision_helmet_use AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct
FROM collision_helmet_use
LIMIT 1
